# voidtools Everything ES

This directory contains the Windows x64 build of the official Everything command-line interface used by the Suo technical validation.

- Component: ES 1.1.0.37 x64
- Source: <https://www.voidtools.com/ES-1.1.0.37.x64.zip>
- SHA-256: `3BE7185707E8023CD9295DBCB7A3FA4092A3D8F52B7FA92A0B84243AB40D12F3`
- License: see `LICENSE.txt`

`es.exe` is only an IPC client. It does not install or start the Everything service and only returns results when a real Everything search client is running in the current user session.
